newsitem.title: USA: American Home says FDA approves new DTP steps.
newsitem.headline: American Home says FDA approves new DTP steps.

text.p: The Food and Drug Administration has for the first time licensed an acellular pertussis vaccine for all five DTP immunization doses, the vaccine's maker, Wyeth-Ayerst Laboratories, said on Monday.
The firm, part of American Home Products Corp., said the new license was for the use of the vaccine, ACEL-IMUNE, for infants at two, four and six months.
It had previously been approved for the fourth and fifth doses in older children, Wyeth-Ayerst said in a statement.
